entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:1
segments: ¶Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour: [so doth] a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom [and] honour. {Dead...: Heb. Flies of death}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:2
segments: A wise man's heart [is] at his right hand; but a fool's heart at his left.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:3
segments: Yea also, when he that is a fool walketh by the way, his wisdom faileth [him], and he saith to every one [that] he [is] a fool. {his...: Heb. his heart}

words.text: Yea also, when he that is a fool
to every one [that] he [is] a fool

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:4
segments: ¶If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:5
segments: There is an evil [which] I have seen under the sun, as an error [which] proceedeth from the ruler: {from: Heb. from before}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:6
segments: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place. {in great...: Heb. in great heights}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:7
segments: I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:8
segments: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it; and whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:9
segments: Whoso removeth stones shall be hurt therewith; [and] he that cleaveth wood shall be endangered thereby.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:10
segments: If the iron be blunt, and he do not whet the edge, then must he put to more strength: but wisdom [is] profitable to direct.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:11
segments: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment; and a babbler is no better. {a babbler: Heb. the master of the tongue}

words.text: . {a babbler: Heb. the master of the tongue}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:12
segments: ¶The words of a wise man's mouth [are] gracious; but the lips of a fool will swallow up himself. {gracious: Heb. grace}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:13
segments: The beginning of the words of his mouth [is] foolishness: and the end of his talk [is] mischievous madness. {his talk: Heb. his mouth}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:14
segments: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell him? {is full...: Heb. multiplieth words}

words.text: what shall be; and what shall be after

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:15
segments: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them, because he knoweth not how to go to the city.

words.text: every one of them, because he knoweth

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:16
segments: ¶Woe to thee, O land, when thy king [is] a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:17
segments: Blessed [art] thou, O land, when thy king [is] the son of nobles, and thy princes eat in due season, for strength, and not for drunkenness!

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:18
segments: By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:19
segments: A feast is made for laughter, and wine maketh merry: but money answereth all [things]. {maketh...: Heb. maketh glad the life}

words.text: all [things]. {maketh...: Heb. maketh glad the life}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 10:20
segments: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter. {thought: or, conscience}
